proposal.description: Telemetry state_out reports the hiccup cool-down as S_OFF, because the power stage is off in both, instead of the registered present state
proposal.reason: Whenever the FSM is in S_HICCUP after an overcurrent window trip, state_out reads S_OFF (2'b00) instead of S_HICCUP (2'b11) for the whole cool-down, while hiccup_active is high.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
proposal.description: In S_RUN the latch read-back latch_state is treated as a recoverable overshoot from a load step and sent to the S_HICCUP cool-down instead of forcing S_OFF
proposal.reason: When latch_state rises in S_RUN, the FSM registers S_HICCUP: hiccup_active goes high and state_out shows S_HICCUP for a clock before S_HICCUP's own check sends it to S_OFF, instead of going straight to S_OFF.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
proposal.description: In S_HICCUP the latch read-back latch_state only holds off the retry, as if the latch were left over from the fault being cooled down, instead of forcing S_OFF
proposal.reason: If latch_state goes high during the cool-down, the FSM stays in S_HICCUP (hiccup_active high, state_out S_HICCUP) instead of going to S_OFF. When the latch clears after hiccup_done, it retries into S_SS on its own.

proposal.description: ss_active is raised in S_OFF as soon as the converter is enabled, as a start request to soft start, a clock before the FSM has registered S_SS
proposal.reason: In S_OFF with en_SW and spi_enable high, ss_active rises a clock before state_out shows S_SS. If a hard fault (OTP, UVLO, latch) blocks start-up, ss_active stays high in S_OFF for as long as the enable is held.

proposal.description: In S_RUN the gate drive is made to depend on the soft-start handshake SS_done, as if regulation were allowed to switch only while the ramp still reports done
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with no fault, en follows SS_done: if SS_done falls or is only a pulse, en drops while the FSM stays in S_RUN and run_active stays high.

before: if (~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
proposal.description: Losing the enable during soft start is handled like a soft-start overcurrent trip and sent through S_HICCUP, as if an aborted ramp had to cool down before turning off
proposal.reason: When en_SW or spi_enable drops in S_SS, the FSM registers S_HICCUP: hiccup_active pulses high and state_out shows S_HICCUP for a clock before S_HICCUP's own check sends it to S_OFF, instead of going straight to S_OFF.
